tags.name: Rewraps
tags.description:
A **rewrap** operation updates the wrapping of vault secret material when the HSM master key is rotated. This ensures that vault seed and signature keys remain usable after HSM key rotation events.

The **vault** polls for pending rewrap requests and submits the rewrapped key material back to the system. The rewrap process is transparent to accounts and does not affect their ability to sign transactions once completed.

Rewrap operations are triggered by a rewrap intent and follow a lazy rotation pattern where vault seeds are rewrapped on-demand rather than all at once.

tags.name: DecryptCbs
tags.description: A **CBS decryption** operation decrypts a confidential MPT balance using the vault's ElGamal key after a MergeInbox transaction on the XRPL. The vault polls for pending decryption requests and submits the decrypted balance back to the system.

tags.name: ParametersCompute
tags.description: A **cMPT parameter computation** operation computes confidential MPT parameters using the vault's ElGamal key as part of the two-step vault protocol. The vault polls for pending computation requests and submits the computed parameters back to the system.
